0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000010_CID
0.description: ...In summary, the isle owes its lofty position to the industry of the Allagans. And we can be all but certain that the archbishop and his cronies are enjoying the view from its top.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000030_CID
2.description: If we are to join them, we will first need to pass through the isle's aetheric barrier─which is, alas, more powerful than most. Powerful enough to make a mess of a perfectly good airship, at any rate...

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000040_CID
3.description: As far as I can gather, the barrier mechanism draws aether from the surrounding environment, and polarizes its elemental aspect to produce what is, in effect, a wall of lightning.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: It seems plain that without the Vanu's key, any attempt to reach the isle will end in failure.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000060_CID
5.description: Alas, the key was careless enough to leave without us, and I don't think the Vanu keep a spare.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000070_AYMERIC
6.description: Master Garlond─based on your experience, is there no other way that we might breach the barrier?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000080_CID
7.description: Well, in the past, we've beaten similar barriers by nullifying them with elemental converters.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000090_CID
8.description: But the one we're up against this time dwarfs aught we've encountered before. The <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103> simply isn't large enough to bear the requisite amount of crystals.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: I am reminded of the quantity needed to nullify Leviathan's command of the sea... A veritable mountain of crystals that could only be borne by lashing two galleons together to form a “twin vessel” scarcely able to propel itself, much less fly.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000110_CID
10.description: That said, we're not without options. If it isn't feasible to nullify the barrier, we might try <hex:021A020203>piercing<hex:021A020103> it.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000130_CID
12.description: We create a ram of condensed aether and mount it on my ship. There's just one problem─I don't have the faintest idea how to build one. It's going to take a true authority in the field, I reckon.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000140_ALPHINAUD
13.description: Would that the Archons were still with us...

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000150_EDMONT
14.description: But yesterday evening, I chanced to find Mistress Tataru in unusually high spirits. Assuming I understood her excited ramblings correctly, she has acquired a clue pointing to the whereabouts of one such individual.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000170_CID
16.description: Hah, fortune favors the righteous, eh? Well then, let's not waste any time. While you go and look for our missing friend, I'll work on modifying the <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103>. Her hull will need reinforcing to bear the punishment, not to mention a mount for the ram.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_000180_CID
17.description: Just you wait, my pretty─by the time I'm finished, you'll be an airship reborn!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100010_KANESENNA
18.description: In requesting the elementals' assistance to find Y'shtola, you must needs be aware of one difficulty─a difficulty born of the fundamental difference between man and elemental.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100030_KANESENNA
20.description: In perceiving the world around him, man relies upon senses such as sight and sound. For the sake of convenience, he gives names to such things as are near or dear to him.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100040_KANESENNA
21.description: Being formed of pure aether, however, such concepts are foreign to the elementals. Instead, they perceive by observing the ebb and flow of the energies of life.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100050_KANESENNA
22.description: So profound a division cannot be bridged with simple discourse. The elementals' voices stir not the air, and thus reach not our ears, while our words are but wind to them.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100060_KANESENNA
23.description: Though we seers can commune with them through feelings, naught that we can impart will serve to aid them in identifying Y'shtola. Nay, they must needs be presented with aether which is akin to hers. If you could but find a family member...

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100070_TATARU
24.description: Oh, I know just the person!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100080_TATARU
25.description: Y'shtola has a sister who came to live in Gridania. She told me about her once.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100090_KANESENNA
26.description: That is most fortunate indeed! Pray seek this sister out, then, and bring her to Everschade.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_100100_KANESENNA
27.description: There, we shall petition the great ones' aid in finding your lost companion.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_200030_KANESENNA
30.description: Hearken to me, O great ones. Pray give yourselves to the Lifestream, a drifting soul to find.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_200040_TATARU
31.description: Please, Y'shtola... Please come back to us...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_200070_KANESENNA
34.description: A room has been readied at the Roost. Pray bear her thither at once.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_200080_KANESENNA
35.description: All that remains is to pray, my friends.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300010_TATARU
36.description: Y'shtola! I'm so glad you're back!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300040_YSHTOLA
39.description: You are safe... Thank the Twelve.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300050_YSHTOLA
40.description: Something has changed about you, Alphinaud. Or mayhap the change is with me? I seem to sense the aether around me more keenly than before.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300060_ALPHINAUD
41.description: I am pleased to see you well again. Do you feel strong enough to talk?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300070_YSHTOLA
42.description: Worry not. I am well enough.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300080_ALPHINAUD
43.description: Tell us, then─what befell you after you fled the feast? We were told that there had been a tunnel collapse.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300090_YSHTOLA
44.description: That was my doing. I brought the tunnel down that you and Minfilia might escape.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300100_YSHTOLA
45.description: At the last moment, I invoked a teleportation magick in hopes of spiriting Thancred away, at least. Needless to say, it did not go quite as planned, and I found myself adrift in the Lifestream.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300110_YSHTOLA
46.description: The others─where are they? Did they not escape?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300120_ALPHINAUD
47.description: They remain unaccounted for. You are the only one we have been able to find.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300130_ALPHINAUD
48.description: I am truly sorry. It was the Crystal Braves who pursued you that day─my hubris that led to our undoing.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300140_YSHTOLA
49.description: No apologies are necessary, Alphinaud─you are not to blame for what occurred. Know that were our comrades here, they would commend you for keeping the light of hope alive.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300150_TATARU
50.description: Don't...don't worry! The others are alive and well, I'm sure of it! We just need to find them!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300160_ALPHINAUD
51.description: Indeed, Tataru. Let us find our friends and rebuild the Scions.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300170_YSHTOLA
52.description: Ha! There is the Alphinaud I remember─and I feel much the better for his return! 'Tis time I arose!

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300180_TATARU
53.description: That reminds me! I have a change of clothes for you! I don't like to boast, but I made them myself. I learned how to weave while we were in Ishgard, you see.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300190_YSHTOLA
54.description: Tataru has apprised me of all that took place in the aftermath of the assassination plot. It would seem I have been away for some while.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300200_ALPHINAUD
55.description: Yes, much and more happened during your absence. At present, we seek to follow the archbishop to Azys Lla.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300210_YSHTOLA
56.description: And you want for some manner of aetheric ram to pierce the floating isle's protective barrier.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300220_ALPHINAUD
57.description: We do. Might you be able to furnish us with one?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300230_YSHTOLA
58.description: A means to prise open a hole in an Allagan barrier─and one large enough to admit an airship, no less... Hm... Nay. I lack the knowledge to devise such a weapon.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300240_YSHTOLA
59.description: ...But I know of one who could.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_300250_YSHTOLA
60.description: A leading figure in the field of aetheric research, and one of the finest scholars ever to grace Sharlayan─Matoya, my former master.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_400010_EDMONT
61.description: To the Thaliak River, whereto the melted snows of Abalathia's Spine<hex:02100103>eventually find their way by means of a thousand silver streams...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_400020_EDMONT
62.description: Whose waters have long nourished the Dravanian hinterlands, and so provided<hex:02100103>for a settlement of learned souls from across the northern seas...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_400030_EDMONT
63.description: To the city of Sharlayan, that great seat of knowledge,<hex:02100103>now abandoned by her keepers, they came.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500010_MATOYA
64.description: Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today─no manners at all...

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500020_YSHTOLA
65.description: Though we neglected to knock, we <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> create something of a commotion. I had hoped that would suffice.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500030_MATOYA
66.description: Heavy-handed as ever, I see. And still not a hint of grace. Some things never change.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500040_YSHTOLA
67.description: To give credit where credit is due─I learned from the best. It has been too long, Master Matoya.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500050_MATOYA
68.description: Indeed it has. It's good to see you again, my girl, and with your fiery spirit unquenched. But look at you─all grown up and womanly.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500060_MATOYA
69.description: ...The one there in the fancy duds─that's Louisoix's granddaughter, I take it?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500070_ALPHINAUD
70.description: Ahem. Grandson, begging your pardons. You knew my grandfather, my lady?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500080_MATOYA
71.description: ...Knew him? We were constantly at each other's throats! Like rabid dogs, we were! He was a stubborn bugger, was your grandfather. Never a dull moment when he was around, though, I'll give him that. As for you, boy, I've known you since you were a rosy-cheeked babe at the teat.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500090_ALPHINAUD
72.description: And my sister, too, I gather. May I say what an honor it is to meet you again, my lady.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500100_MATOYA
73.description: Spare me the hollow pleasantries, boy. I'll wager my remaining good teeth you didn't come to a forgotten corner of Eorzea to flirt with a wrinkly old woman. Now, out with it─what is it you need of me?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500110_MATOYA
74.description: Azys Lla... I never thought I'd hear that name again...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500130_MATOYA
76.description: As familiar as one can get from poring over musty old tomes. The Allagans set the isle afloat not long before the sun set on their empire. Old Louisoix and I often talked about it.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500140_MATOYA
77.description: The place is home to a research facility dedicated to finding ways of mastering mighty beings such as primals and dragons. And find ways it did, too─<hex:021A020203>frightening<hex:021A020103> ones.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500150_MATOYA
78.description: Such secrets as lie buried on Azys Lla aren't fit to see the light of day. And now you tell me a band of dragon-baiting primal-botherers are trying to dig them up!?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500160_ALPHINAUD
79.description: Indeed. And to make matters worse, the Ascians have a hand in their plot. They must be stopped, no matter the cost.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500180_YSHTOLA
81.description: You will help us, then? Truly? I had not anticipated such an impassioned response. Could it be that the presence of young blood has stirred your own?

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_500190_MATOYA
82.description: Ah, some things never change... One day, that pertness is going to cost you your tail, my girl. Don't say I didn't warn you.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600010_MATOYA
83.description: 'Twas some fifty years ago, shortly after Garlemald had brought all of Ilsabard under its rule.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600020_MATOYA
84.description: Faced with the threat of invasion, the people of Sharlayan scrambled about for a means to resist the Empire. For my part, I was tasked with developing an aetheric converger.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600030_YSHTOLA
85.description: Ah, yes, a device which draws in aether and concentrates it to produce a destructive force.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600040_MATOYA
86.description: But as my research neared its end, it was denounced by the Forum, who claimed that my device was more likely to destroy us than our enemies.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600050_MATOYA
87.description: After that, they and I had a little falling-out, and I decided to seal away all the fruits of my research, lest the dunderheaded ingrates reap any benefit. Petty, I know, but gods, it was satisfying!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600060_YSHTOLA
88.description: Do mine ears deceive? 'Twas you, was it not, who was so fond of saying that all knowledge exists to advance mankind? That how it is used depends on us?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600070_MATOYA
89.description: I don't remember. Perhaps. All right, yes, that was a pet phrase of mine. And that should give you a notion of how sick and tired I was of those spineless wretches of the Forum. All talk and no trousers, that lot. That's why I decided to remain behind rather than join the exodus.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600080_ALPHINAUD
90.description: You may have had your disagreements with my grandfather, but upon that point, your minds were as one.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600090_YSHTOLA
91.description: With respect, Master─the fruits of your research should not be left to spoil. Will you share with us the secrets of the aetheric converger?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600100_MATOYA
92.description: Aye, I will. All the information you need is contained in a tome I wrote on the subject. But you'll have to fetch it from the forbidden section of the Great Library.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600110_YSHTOLA
93.description: You were not exaggerating when you said that you had sealed it away. Though the city is abandoned, the library's guardians are all but certain to remain. We must needs cut a path through them. Come─let us away.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_600120_MATOYA
94.description: Not so fast! You don't expect that you can just waltz on in, now, do you?

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_610010_ALPHINAUD
96.description: So this is the tome. Excellent.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_610020_ALPHINAUD
97.description: Let us take it to Master Matoya at once.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700010_MATOYA
98.description: I had not thought to behold this tome again...

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700020_MATOYA
99.description: There. It is deciphered. Now your friend should be able to make sense of the contents.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700030_MATOYA
100.description: That said, it's one thing to understand the workings of the aetheric converger, and another to actually make it work. You do realize how much aether is required?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700040_ALPHINAUD
101.description: Cid is keenly aware of the energy dilemma. His airship is by no means large, and it can only bear a limited quantity of crystals.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700050_YSHTOLA
102.description: If only we had white auracite and the aetheric siphon...

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700060_ALPHINAUD
103.description: Alas, Minfilia is missing, along with both artifacts. And Moenbryda is gone...

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700070_YSHTOLA
104.description: Would that there were another ready wellspring of energy for us to draw upon...

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700080_ALPHINAUD
105.description: Why did it not occur to us before?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700090_ALPHINAUD
106.description: We already have what we need: the Eye!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700100_ALPHINAUD
107.description: It has been drawing aether into itself for as long as the great wyrms have lived! It is a veritable wellspring of energy!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700110_MATOYA
108.description: Hm, it might just suit our needs. But is this energy something that can be harnessed at will?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700120_ALPHINAUD
109.description: I believe so─with the aid of the Azure Dragoon of Ishgard.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700130_YSHTOLA
110.description: Then it is settled. Let us return to the Holy See at once.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700150_MATOYA
112.description: When did the light fade from your eyes?

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700160_YSHTOLA
113.description: I might have known that it would not escape your notice. It has been this way since I returned from the Lifestream. An aftereffect of the teleportation magick I invoked, most like.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700170_MATOYA
114.description: They are called “forbidden spells” for a reason. What were you thinking, girl?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700180_YSHTOLA
115.description: I have no regrets. I but did what was necessary to preserve the light of hope─to keep my promise to Minfilia.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700190_YSHTOLA
116.description: Besides, it afforded me the rare opportunity to wander the aether─a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700200_MATOYA
117.description: I need not tell you that it consumes your very life force to see by sensing the aether around you. Take care of yourself, do you hear me?

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_700210_YSHTOLA
118.description: I will, Master Matoya. And thank you.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800010_YSHTOLA
119.description: Until but recently, the Ishgardians had kept their doors firmly shut to outsiders.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800020_YSHTOLA
120.description: But thanks to you, we have found in them stout allies, with whom we may fight to secure the future of the realm. Truly, you are the beacon of hope towards which all men are drawn.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800030_ESTINIEN
121.description: Spare us the hyperbole. 'Tis not for praise that we fight.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800040_YSHTOLA
122.description: Oh? In light of all we have achieved, I felt it only meet to express my gratitude.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800050_ESTINIEN
123.description: All that we have achieved? Hmph. Spoken like a true outsider. Until the war is over, we have achieved nothing.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800060_ESTINIEN
124.description: The coming battle is a chance to excise the root of this conflict, and by my hand, it shall be done. <hex:021A020203>Then<hex:021A020103> you may speak of achievement.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800070_YSHTOLA
125.description: 'Twas not mine intent to make light of your struggle. If I have given offense, then I apologize. But if I may speak freely, you would do well to be wary of the Eye. Even now, it burns with insatiable hatred, watching unblinking for a sign of weakness. Should you falter for so much as a moment, it will surely consume you.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800080_ESTINIEN
126.description: Save your concern. I will consume the Eye ere I let it consume me.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800090_URIANGER
127.description: Twelve be praised, thou hast not yet set forth!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800100_URIANGER
128.description: 'Cross sand and snow have I journeyed, that I might deliver this gift unto thee.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800110_YSHTOLA
129.description: White auracite... But whence did it come?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800120_URIANGER
130.description: To mine amazement, it lay hid amongst Moenbryda's last effects. 'Twas but blind chance, or providence, that I did hap to spy it. Let no man claim that my late friend e'er erred for lack of foresight.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03006_800130_URIANGER
131.description: In the place whither thou goest, servants of Darkness do lie in wait. Pray give unto me thy pledge that thou wilt strike them down and avenge our fallen comrade.
